subject: Post-demo: granular feature costing & CAC payback plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Kai Jensen <kai@carevoyage.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: granular feature costing & CAC payback plan

Hi Kai / Sarah —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through CareVoyage's intake flow and the 3 features you flagged for the pilot (smart triage, clinical summarization, and outbound care nudges). Per the ask in the demo, I pulled together a short workbook that maps token volumes to per-feature marginal cost, and a first-pass pilot pricing suggestion for a 90-day run. See attached: carevoyage-econ-workbook.xlsx.

Quick recap and things we need from you to land a pilot SOW:
- Confirm expected monthly MAU for the pilot window (rough bands are fine: 50k / 200k / 1M active users).
- Typical prompts per user-per-session and avg tokens per prompt — we used 3 prompts/session and ~600 tokens/prompt as a placeholder.
- Target unit economics you care about: target $/1M tokens (you mentioned $2k-$3k range verbally), and a payback window for feature-driven CAC (30 / 90 / 180 days).
- Procurement timeline and whether SOC 2 / KMS docs need to be attached to the SOW.

Ben and Karthik included a short note below that sketches margin sensitivity vs inference spend (we're targeting a >60% gross margin at scale for typical payer workflows). If you can share the volume bands by EOD Fri we'll update the workbook and come back with a per-feature price ladder and recommended pilot discount structure.

Next steps (proposal):
1) You share volume ranges + procurement touchpoints (Kai).
2) We run a 45min econ deep-dive workshop with your product and finance (we suggested Wed next week; propose two time slots).
3) Sign pilot SOW (draft attached: pilot-sow-draft.docx) for 90 days and a canary of 0.5M tokens/day to validate cost-per-feature assumptions.

Attachments: carevoyage-econ-workbook.xlsx, pilot-sow-draft.docx

—Lauren

Subject: Re: Post-demo: granular feature costing & CAC payback plan

Thanks Lauren — solid recap. A few quick answers and clarifying points: 

Volumes (pilot bands):
- Conservative: 40k MAU (we're unlikely to hit this in Q4 but want baseline)
- Mid: 180k MAU (our target for Q1)
- Aggressive: 950k MAU (12-month aspiration)

Prompts: average patient session is 2.2 prompts; we run one API call for triage (~700 tokens), one for summarization (~1100 tokens), and outbound messages ~300 tokens each. That averages about 2100 tokens/session in our sampling.

Budget band: our finance lead suggested an initial target of $1,800–$2,400 / 1M tokens as a negotiation band — we'd prefer to hit closer to $1,800 if quality and latency meet SLAs.

Payback: we measure feature payback over 90 days; a 60–90 day CAC payback is ideal.

Procurement: SOC 2 and our legal team will want KMS/HSM details. Can you attach an evidence pack or point us to a shared folder? Also curious about an introductory commitment size that would get us the $1,800 band.

Happy to do the deep-dive workshop. Wed next week works — can do Wed 10/22 or Thu 10/23 (we're in PST).

—Kai
Product Ops — CareVoyage
kai@carevoyage.ai


-----Original Message-----
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: granular feature costing & CAC payback plan

LAUREN / TEAM —

Adding a couple of concrete numbers so we can be ready for the deep-dive: attached snapshot (redwood-cost-snapshot.pdf) is a working calculation based on Kai's per-session token estimate (2.1k tokens/session). Key assumptions:
- Optimized batching and prefix caching yields ~35% token-cost reduction on triage-heavy flows once KV caching warms.
- Using our q4 reserved-quantization profile (int8), we can price inference execution at ~$0.28 – $0.36 per 1k tokens at scale. That translates to $588–$756 per 1M tokens raw compute.
- Add model licensing / SLO ops at ~$600–$1,200 per 1M tokens depending on throughput SLAs and support tier.

So blended cost/1M tokens (compute + infra/service) approx: $1,200 – $1,950 depending on commitment and SLAs.

Per-feature mapping (ballpark for the pilot):
- Smart triage (dominant tokens): ~55% of total token usage → implied marginal cost band $660–$1,073 per 1M tokens attributable
- Summarization: ~30% → $360–$585 per 1M tokens
- Outbound nudges: ~15% → $180–$293 per 1M tokens

Margin targets: to hit >60% gross margin at Redwood we generally need final list pricing at ~2.5–3x blended cost/1M tokens (so roughly $3,000–$4,800 per 1M tokens list), with pilot discounts available for first 90 days. To land Kai's $1,800 target we'd need a minimum committed monthly token volume (we typically start that at a 5M token/mo commit for the tier).

Actionable asks for the workshop:
- Kai to confirm volume band selection + procurement timeline (already requested).
- Marissa to prepare a two-slide pilot discount / commit ladder (Marissa: can you pull together two commit bands: 1M/mo and 5M/mo and what the blended cost + pilot discount looks like?)

Ben
Ben Carter
Product Pricing — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood-cost-snapshot.pdf
